dex.entry: A marble-sized wandering coal-sprite with a single bright eye; it rolls into warm crevices in Cinderhead Mine and hums contentedly. The smallest, round-est creature in the mine — impossibly cute in its simplicity.

art.silhouette: Near-perfect sphere, dull black coal texture with a single amber-glow eye, two tiny round feet; the simplest possible round silhouette at 32px.
